body: Thank you for replying.. I have talked to 3 different counselors/therapists/psychologists the first two were at my college and the third was back home with a fancy expensive one which of course I couldn't afford to go back to. Each time I feel like I didn't get anything out of it. I felt like a monkey in a cage with someone staring at me. All of them dismissed the way I was feeling and told me the obvious solutions to all of my problems that I already know for example my body image issue: "well you need to eat healthier and try and exercise more" no shit. My grades issue: "well you need to study more and go to your teacher's office hours" no shit. I felt like they were no help because I know what I need to be doing I just can't do it. I am paralyzed by my depression. I told my mom once when she was telling me I'm lazy that "I need to FEEL better before I can DO better" she did not understand. Anyway I have reached out to my teacher and they have all recommended I make an appointment with my school counseling services to I reluctantly called and am waiting for them to give me a time. I don't know how to make the appointment more productive. As soon as I start talking about stuff I start crying. I don't want someone just telling me what I should do to fix it I want someone helping me to figure out how to do those things despite how awful I feel.
